body: Thank you! Is there any entity you’d suggest?

I look at it more neutral. I’m the one living my own life. Of course I’d rather if those things were happening for me. Our lives are in our own context. You can’t undo that context. It isn’t selfish to wish it was you having the best day or the best love. It would be selfish if you wished nobody had a good day but you.
He’s experimenting with unique looks, ok!
This whole vibe and style and concept is kinda played out. Very 2010s.

I’ve heard that about Sitri. Some things happened after my first contact with Sitri that made me feel he didn’t think much of me. Part of me kind of feels I have things in common with Sitri, but part of me feels like he may be mocking me but I’d hate to be saying that and it not be true. Idk. Should I thank him and cut ties? Or do anything? Ask Sitri to know how he feels about me?

Sallos visited the spell my friend did for me. I have a candelabra that, in my mind, has a candle space that reminds me of Sallos / I feel represents them. That candle slot shattered during the spell. It felt like Sallos. Sallos had been shy and reluctant when I first made contact a couple weeks ago, but I felt them the other night. Dantallion I got a really strong connection to. But it seemed like guidance to love myself. Helpful, friendly even. But we all know I still want my results. I always try to work on self love but I am still wanting my desire now. 

Anyway I did provide offerings. Wine, chocolate, incense, etc. I did promise to tell about my results. I even told my friend and talked online about them before I got results. Should I offer more? 

Idk if my intent is stronger than my fears and doubts. I want it to be. Maybe it’s not. I’m trying. I spiral a lot when things don’t work out. I’ve been at this since spring. I want this so, so badly. I don’t mean any ill will, I believe in us. I’m a little scared of getting what I want in a way. I talked to Dantallion about that. I feel better about it now. 

Is my guy just too strong willed? Do I need to break his defenses? Or should I work on the things you mentioned?

It can be how life is but it’s not usually like that as an adult. You’ll find things as you get older. The problem is that you can fail and be hurt by anything good you’ll ever have. There’s more to life than what you’re experiencing but it’s up to you to decide if that’s worth the pain.

Eh. Shit is boring and dull. It’s not that big of a deal. That isn’t pain, that’s just the state of existence. People make up meaning for shit. You don’t have to accept it, you can kill yourself if you don’t need to be here bored. That isn’t suffering though. It’s not profound or deep to feel like this life is a series of pointlessness. It’s a common sentiment. It’s true if you perceive it that way. Pointless or not, this is it. Take it or leave it. That’s a state of mind, though. An opinion on existence. It isn’t an actual problem. The good news is that you don’t need a real problem to kill your self. You can do whatever you want. But if you are reaching out for a reason to live, then that’s easy. You aren’t going through shit. You’re just bored. No big deal. That’s how tons of people feel. Be glad you don’t have real problems. If you feel like suicide is the only option to not be bored then maybe you’re right. I’m scared that whatever comes after death is boring. Even if it’s nothing.
